message.jaymoskingdoms.kneel.lock: Kneel to pick the lock: get low (Shift + scroll down) and hold still, then use it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.kneel.shackle: Kneel to work at the shackle: get low (Shift + scroll down) and hold still, then use the lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.kneel.chain: Kneel to beat at the chain: get low (Shift + scroll down) and hold still, then use the rock.
message.jaymoskingdoms.kneel.rope: Kneel to saw at the rope: get low (Shift + scroll down) and hold still, then use the blade.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.169: Get low (Shift + scroll down) and hold still to kneel. From a kneel you pick locks, work at chains and ropes, and see to the downed: hold use to bring them round, tap it to lift them.
